faqs.title: How do I get a quote?

data.question: How do I get a quote?
data.answer: Text or email Remy with your address and what you need. For most new yards, Remy will book a quick look before giving the final price.

data.question: Do you show prices online?
data.answer: Not yet. Lawns can be very different, so quotes are given after seeing the yard, the access, and the amount of work needed.

data.question: Where do you work?
data.answer: The Lawn Guy Bradford serves Bradford West Gwillimbury only at launch.

faqs.title: What does a standard mow include?

data.question: What does a standard mow include?
data.answer: A standard mow includes cutting the lawn, trimming around key areas, blowing hard surfaces clean, and mulching clippings by default when conditions allow.

data.question: What if it rains or the lawn is unsafe to cut?
data.answer: If weather or lawn conditions make the cut unsafe or likely to look bad, Remy will reschedule as soon as practical.

faqs.title: Do I need to be home?

data.question: Do I need to be home?
data.answer: For the first quote visit, it helps if you are available. For future mowing visits, Remy can usually work from access instructions.

faqs.title: What should I do before a visit?

data.question: What should I do before a visit?
data.answer: Please clear pet waste and mention any hidden hazards. Besides that, Remy will handle the yard-care work that is in the quote.

data.question: Do you handle overgrown lawns?
data.answer: Yes, but overgrown lawns are quoted separately because they can take more time and may need a different first-cut approach.

faqs.title: Do you offer weed or grub treatments?

data.question: Do you offer weed or grub treatments?
data.answer: Remy can look at lawn-health concerns during the quote visit. Paid pesticide, herbicide, grub, or pest treatments should not be advertised until Ontario licensing and product-label requirements are confirmed.
